tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground: ink in dark, paper in light. The film grain sits over it.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Card and bar surfaces: panel cards, artifact cards, console head, toolbar, TOC, shell header.

tokens.name: panel-2
tokens.usage: Raised or recessed second surface: drawers, the selected rail item, pressed segmented buttons, select options.

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: Wells inside surfaces: inputs, textareas, code blocks. Sits a step below panel in both themes: near-black in dark, paper (the bg value) in light, so a well reads as sunken on a white panel.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline: card borders, row dividers, header rule. Depth comes from these blue-tinted lines, not a gray ramp.

tokens.name: line-bright
tokens.usage: Stronger hairline: control borders, table head rules, neutral tag borders. Decorative: 1.7:1 on panel in dark and 1.8:1 in light, below 3:1, so meaning never rides on it alone.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, panel, panel-2 and inset in both themes (17:1 and up).

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, table heads, meta lines, footers. On panel 6.9:1 dark, 9.7:1 light.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Strong secondary text, between ink and dim: settled card titles, list items under a heading, confidence words in tables, reviewer notes. On panel about 12:1 dark and 13:1 light.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: placeholders, quiet counts, disabled controls. Misses 4.5:1: on panel 3.0:1 dark and 4.0:1 light, and 3.6:1 as a placeholder on the light inset; keep it to non-essential text.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Brand blue as a FILL: primary button, current phase box, toast, focus border on inputs. White on it reads 9.2:1. As text on dark surfaces it reads 2.1:1, so dark text uses blue-bright.

tokens.name: blue-bright
tokens.usage: Blue as TEXT and focus ring: links, IDs, list markers, the active tab underline, the pressed filter border. On panel 4.5:1 dark (4.47, a hair under; source value kept) and 11.7:1 light.

tokens.name: blue-deep
tokens.usage: Deepest blue step, declared for both themes; link hover in light.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Acid chartreuse, the rare signal: the live watching dot and the logo's middle stripe in dark. Never body text, never a chip, tab or button fill. In light it is 1.1:1 on bg, so it swaps to blue there.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Open states: OPEN chips, needs-attention counts, watches due within 14 days. On panel 12.4:1 dark, 6.6:1 light.

tokens.name: warn-fill
tokens.usage: OPEN as a non-text fill: chart segments such as the Ledger calibration bars. Light warn (#8e4b10) sits too close to bad and ok in lightness to tell apart as a bar. Light value is 3.4:1 on panel: enough for a graphic, never for text.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Validated and healthy states: VALIDATED and APPROVE chips, validated bar segments. On panel 8.7:1 dark, 6.4:1 light.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Invalidated and high-risk states: INVALIDATED chips, invalidated bar segments. On panel 7.7:1 dark, 4.7:1 light. Always paired with a word, never hue alone.

tokens.name: unk
tokens.usage: Unknown or unverifiable states: UNKNOWN chips and bar segments. On panel 7.7:1 dark, 7.0:1 light.

tokens.name: code-fg
tokens.usage: Inline code text on code-bg (9.0:1 dark, 6.4:1 light).

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Inline code ground, drawn as a tint with no border so code never crowds the line above or below.

tokens.name: baseline
tokens.usage: The grid unit. Every line height, vertical padding, margin, gap and fixed height is a multiple of it.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to its value, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips and buttons in a row, between stacked cards, rail item padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell and card head vertical padding, list item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, paragraph spacing, gap between field rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Drawer and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Top-bar side padding, grid gutters, page side gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above an eyebrow heading inside a section, ticket header to phase row.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page top padding, between sections inside a phase.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page side padding on wide screens, before page-level links.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Before the cited-decisions table at the end of a phase.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Page bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner. The system is square: buttons, inputs, tabs, chips and cards all set border-radius 0.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: The ONE shadow: toast and the ⋯ menu. Everything else separates by hairlines.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar height, border included.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Expanded tickets sidebar; it wraps above the content under 820px.

tokens.name: rail-collapsed
tokens.usage: Collapsed tickets sidebar: show button, needs-attention count, current ticket ID.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Ticket column; prose inside it caps at 72ch.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Wide views: Watches, Ledger, New task, landing page.

tokens.name: chip-s-height
tokens.usage: Small chip box.

tokens.name: chip-m-height
tokens.usage: Medium chip box, phase boxes.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Standard button and segmented control.

tokens.name: input-height
tokens.usage: Form inputs and selects; 32px in the sidebar filter and inline rows.

tokens.name: table-row
